Column split also varies: p07 is 4 left/2 right, p08 3/3, p09 3/2, p10 4/3, p11 2/2. Numbering always runs DOWN the left column then DOWN the right. BAND EDGES: Q37 is complete and starts cleanly at the top of p07 (B1 ends at Q36 at the foot of p06, nothing spills). Q64 is complete and ends mid-page on p11, which has substantial whitespace below it; p12 (B3's territory) opens with Q65 left / Q68 right, so nothing of mine runs over and nothing of B3's is stranded here. CODE-BLOCK ORDERS, each cropped and read at 9-12x rather than inferred: Q41 and Q48 are Match Lists whose four code rows are character-for-character IDENTICAL (2134 / 2314 / 4312 / 4132) — verified independently on both pages, this is genuinely what the booklet prints.
